optionsEn: The court may direct that person or authority
That he himself recognizes his signature
Any other person recognizes his signature before the court
Such digital signature is not admissible in any
optionsHi: न्यायालय उस व्यक्ति या प्राधिकारी को निर्देश दे सकता है
